cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.69%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.55%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: BE +6.49%, GEV +4.92%, AR +3.49%, VRT +3.28%, BWXT +3.15%. Laggards: EOSE -5.80%, ENPH -4.24%, SEDG -4.23%, LEU -3.84%.
